chapter: Billy Pierce Studio and New York tap
title: Working as a stand-in assistant for Bradley
summary: Billy Pierce gives him the job of Bradley's assistant; Henry LeTang's lessons with Powell were dropped and she took her favourite shoes.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Now, that was a job that Mr. Pierce, Billy Pierce gave me, see I could be like a Buddy Bradley assistant dancer, see. You know, but --
Were there other assistants also working then?
Yeah, well, it was one guy in there, but he was an undeveloped dancer too, I mean, Henry LeTang. See, (inaudible), See, and Eleanor Powell, she discontinued Henry LeTang's lesson, because

she was in a hurry. She had to learn something quick, you know. So she was pleased with the idea of -- she could inject her ballet into tap dancing, because she thought that would be more impressive. See, they allowed her to make the movie without a screen test, you know. That's what a great -- that's how great a dancer she was.
So you initially taught her how to tap?

Well, yeah, then first -- I actually finished, like attached on to what she had learned. She showed me what she had learned from Buddy Bradley without the taps on, but it was actually tap dancing, see, but she didn't -- she liked these shoes. I'm telling you it was a favorite shoe. Dancers was like that in those days. They had a favorite pair of shoes that they liked to dance in. You understand? So by the time she got the taps on to the shoes, Mr. Buddy Bradley, he had left, you know. He had caught the boat and gone to England, see. And so I just did that, you know --
